The difference is substantial:

Car charging method

If you're looking for the **fastest portable power station to charge from a car while driving**, the key is to use a **dedicated alternator charger**, rather than the standard 12V cigarette-lighter outlet.

The difference is substantial:

| Car charging method | Typical charging power |
|---|---:|
| 12V cigarette-lighter outlet | 100–120W |
| High-output 12V socket | Up to ~240W |
| Dedicated alternator charger | 500–1,000W+ |

For example, a 1,000Wh power station could take 9–12 hours to recharge from a standard car outlet, versus roughly 1–2 hours with a compatible 800W alternator charger.
